questions.prompt_html: \text{单叶双曲面} \frac{x^{2}}{4}+2y^{2}-\frac{z^{2}}{3}=1 \text{上点} M \text{处的法向量与三坐标轴正向的夹角相等，则点} M \text{为( ).}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{设}F(x,y,z)=\frac{x^{2}}{4}+2y^{2}-\frac{z^{2}}{3}-1,\ \text{则}F_{x}=\frac{x}{2},\ F_{y}=4y,\ F_{z}=-\frac{2z}{3},\text{由题意可得}\frac{x}{2}=4y=-\frac{2z}{3},\ \text{设}\\&M_{0}(x_{0},y_{0},z_{0})\ ,\ \text{则可得到}\ \frac{x_{0}^{2}}{4}+2y_{0}^{2}-\frac{z_{0}^{2}}{3}=1\ ,\ \ \frac{x_{0}}{2}=4y_{0}=-\frac{2z_{0}}{3}\ ,\ \text{解得}(x_{0},y_{0},z_{0})=\\&(\frac{4}{3}\sqrt{6},\frac{1}{6}\sqrt{6},-\sqrt{6})\text{或者}(-\frac{4}{3}\sqrt{6},-\frac{1}{6}\sqrt{6},\sqrt{6}).\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{设} F(x,y,z)=\ln \frac{x}{z}+y-z\;，\text{则} F_{x}|_{p}=\frac{z}{\frac{x}{z}}=1\;，\; F_{y}|_{p}=1\;，\; F_{z}|_{p}=\frac{-\frac{x}{z}}{\frac{x}{z}}-1=-\frac{1}{z}-1=-2\;，\text{法线方程为}：\\& \quad x-1=y-1=\frac{z-1}{-2}\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {由题设可得：曲面} F(x,y,z)=0 \text {的法向量为：} (4\sqrt{2},4,4),\, xOy \text {平面的法向量为：} (0,0,1), \text {则两} \\ \text {平面夹角的余弦为：} \cos \theta = \frac{\left|4\sqrt{2}\cdot 0+4\cdot 0+4\cdot 1\right|}{\sqrt{(4\sqrt{2})^{2}+4^{2}+4^{2}\sqrt{1}}} = \frac{1}{2}, \text {两平面夹角为：} \frac{\pi}{3}. \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{曲面}x \ln(y+2z)+x^{2}y+3z- \frac{3}{2}=0 \text{在点}(-1,0, \frac{1}{2}) \text{处的法线方程为( } \quad.).
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{设} F(x,y,z)=x\ln(y+2z)+x^2y+3z-\frac{3}{2}\ ,\ \text{则}\\& \ F_x\big|_{(-1,0,\frac{1}{2})}=\ln(y+2z)+2xy=0\ ,\ \ F_y\big|_{(-1,0,\frac{1}{2})}=\frac{x}{y+2z}+x^2=0\ ,\ \ F_z\big|_{(-1,0,\frac{1}{2})}=\frac{2x}{y+2z}+3=1\ ,\\& \text{法线方程为：}\ \frac{x+1}{0}=\frac{y}{0}=\frac{z-\frac{1}{2}}{1}.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{曲面}3x^{2}+5y^{2}-2z=2 \text{在点}(1,1,3)\text{处的法线方程为}( ).
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{设}F(x,y,z)=3x^2+5y^2-2z-2,\text{则：}\\&F_x(x,y,z)=6x,\ F_y(x,y,z)=10y,\ F_z(x,y,z)=-2,\\&F_x(1,1,3)=6,\ F_y(1,1,3)=10,\ F_z(1,1,3)=-2,\\&\text{在点}(1,1,3)\text{处的法线方程为}：\\&\frac{x-1}{6}=\frac{y-1}{10}=\frac{z-3}{-2},\ \text{即}\ \frac{x-1}{3}=\frac{y-1}{5}=\frac{z-3}{-1}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由点}(3,-2,1) \text{在曲面}F(x+y+z,xyz)=0 \text{上}，\text{则}F(2,-6)=0，\text{曲面在点}(3,-2,1)\text{处的偏导数为}：\\&\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial F}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial F}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=4\cdot 1+2\cdot (-2)\cdot 1=0,\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial F}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial F}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=10,\frac{\partial F}{\partial z}=\frac{\partial F}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial F}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}=-8,\\&\text{则曲面的切平面为：}10(y+2)-8(z-1)=0，\text{即}：5y-4z+14=0.\end{aligned}
